description: Get one Sejm print (druk): title, dates, attachment file names, associated prints and the legislative processes it belongs to.

printNumber.description: Number of the print, e.g. 1070, or 1070-A for an additional print: the `number` field from get-prints

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-print

attachments.description: File names of the attachments (usually PDF and DOCX)

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

processPrint.description: Prints that started the legislative processes this print belongs to

title: Get a print
